title: Traefik Mesh Service Entry
description: A Kubernetes service entry in the Traefik Mesh topology, representing a service participating in the mesh.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the service belongs to.

ports.description: List of ports exposed by the service.

trafficType.description: Traffic protocol type configured for this service in the mesh.

annotations.description: Kubernetes service annotations that configure Traefik Mesh behavior.
